name: Concrete notice days but no buyout / handover / LWD discussion
notes: Phase 2.1: notice_period_shallow fires when notice is concrete but lacks depth.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I'm a senior engineer with 7 years at Swiggy working on order management systems.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Why are you considering a switch?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Looking for ownership of a larger problem space — Swiggy has matured and I want to be back in the 0-to-1 zone.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: What's your notice period? When can you join us?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: 60 days. I can join in two months from offer acceptance.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Tell me about a project where you owned the design end to end.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I designed the new payouts pipeline that processes 2M transactions a day. Owned it from spec to launch over four months.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I've followed your engineering blog — especially the recent piece on tiered consensus. The infra problems you're solving line up with where I want to grow.
